description: Earth's Pulse turns complex NASA environmental data into an interactive, jukebox-style experience for exploring our planet's health.
summary: Earth's Pulse is an innovative analytical and storytelling platform designed to document, track, and visualize the historical equipment and hardware left behind on the Moon and Mars from past space exploration missions. Utilizing NASA’s open datasets and geospatial records, our solution transforms complex mission logs into an accessible, interactive experience that highlights the scientific legacy, spatial distribution, and environmental impact of these celestial artifacts. By bridging data analytics with engaging narratives, the project raises public awareness about space heritage while providing researchers and enthusiasts with valuable insights to support sustainable future space exploration.
details:
Project Overview & Functionality:

Mars Relics is an innovative analytical and storytelling platform designed to document, track, and visualize historical equipment, rovers, and hardware components left behind on the Moon and Mars. The platform transforms complex mission logs and geospatial data into an intuitive, interactive experience.

Key Benefits & Impact:

The project bridges raw aerospace data with engaging narratives to raise public awareness about space heritage. It serves as a valuable resource for researchers, educators, and space enthusiasts by analyzing the spatial distribution and environmental impact of past exploration missions.

Tools, Technologies & Development:

  • Data Sources: NASA open datasets and mission logs.
  • Technologies: Developed using Python and data analytics/visualization frameworks to process telemetry and geospatial information efficiently.
  • Design Approach: Focused on user-centric design principles to ensure complex technical data is accessible and engaging.

Creativity & Team Considerations:

Our project uniquely combines rigorous data analysis with creative storytelling, turning discarded space hardware into an educational narrative about the footprint of human space exploration.
